## Problem 1

### a.

```{r}
library(foreign)

# read the data
aux <- read.xport("AUX_I.xpt")
dem <- read.xport("DEMO_I.xpt")

# merge the data
merged <- merge(aux, dem, by = "SEQN", all = FALSE)

names(merged) <- tolower(names(merged))
dim(merged)
```

### b.

1. gender
```{r}
table(merged$riagendr, useNA = 'ifany')

# rename
names(merged)[names(merged) == "riagendr"] <- "female"

# convert to 0 = male and 1 = female
merged$female <- merged$female - 1

# create a table
table(merged$female, useNA = 'ifany')
```
gender : no missing value, rename, no need to make binary variables factors.

2. citizenship status
```{r}
table(merged$dmdcitzn, useNA = 'ifany')

# convert invalid or missing to NA
merged$dmdcitzn[merged$dmdcitzn > 3] <- NA

# convert to a factor
merged$dmdcitzn <- as.factor(merged$dmdcitzn)
levels(merged$dmdcitzn) <- c(
  "Citizen",
  "Not a citizen"
)

# rename
names(merged)[names(merged) == "dmdcitzn"] <- "citizenship"

table(merged$citizenship, useNA = "ifany")
```
3. # of children
```{r}
# rename
names(merged)[names(merged) == "dmdhhsza"] <- "numchild"

table(merged$numchild, useNA = "ifany")
```

4. annual household income
```{r}
table(merged$indhhin2, useNA = 'ifany')

# convert refused, dk, and overlapping income categories to NA
merged$indhhin2[
  merged$indhhin2 > 15 |
  merged$indhhin2 %in% c(12, 13)
] <- NA

# rename
names(merged)[names(merged) == "indhhin2"] <- "hhinc"

merged$hhinc[merged$hhinc == 14] <- 11
merged$hhinc[merged$hhinc == 15] <- 12
table(merged$hhinc, useNA = 'ifany')

# check the cleaned variable
table(merged$hhinc, useNA = "ifany")
```
